title: Authorize every protected action and object
summary: Authentication alone is insufficient; every protected action must verify that the caller is allowed to act on the requested resource.
review_checks: List state-changing and sensitive read endpoints.
Confirm policy checks happen server-side for the action and target object.
safe_tests: Use local test identities with distinct roles and object ownership.
Confirm forbidden responses do not disclose protected data.
remediation: Centralize policy enforcement near protected operations.
Default to deny and add tests for cross-user and cross-role access.
